title: Horizontal compatibility of normalized finite root-line comparisons
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y, f:X→Y and normalized tower Geometry g with Base b [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. Let cY,cX be Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. Suppose for every n a finite-line isomorphism delta_n from the actual constant-ring inverse image of finiteLine(cY,n) to finiteLine(cX,n) is given [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal, def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], and its ordinary finite adjunct sends each a tensor z to the actual constant direct-image image of a tensor restrictRoot(z) [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. Conjugate delta_n by lineEvaluation on X and Y and g.ordinaryPullEvaluation, obtaining d_n between the evaluations of g.pull(lineModule(cY)) and lineModule(cX). Then for every n≤m, transition_X(n≤m) followed by restriction of d_n equals d_m followed by transition_X(n≤m). This asserts the horizontal equation for already given finite comparisons; it constructs neither those comparisons nor a system isomorphism.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension of the roots tower; horizontal transition calculation of lem-sfb-tower-class-line-pullback-existence

proof.text: Conjugate the two horizontal composites by the inverse source pull/line evaluations at m and the target line evaluation at n. Transpose with the actual level-m adjunction. The finite Tate-line universal property reduces equality to values on unit tensors 1 tensor z.

The proved lower-path unit-tensor lemma computes the first adjunct using only the comparison at n. Ring homomorphisms preserve one, so the given all-coefficient normalization supplies both needed unit-tensor formulas. Naturality of the finite adjunction computes the other adjunct as the comparison at m followed by the actual X transition. The proved lineEvaluation HEq transition formula, and the fact that scalar restriction keeps the same underlying map, give the same inverse tensor generator. The target evaluation cancels its inverse, giving the identical finite root tensor. Cancel the evaluation isomorphisms, including the component identities of the natural pull evaluation.

proof_origin.place: classes (2); finite adjunction transposition and separate path calculations after actual-unit geometry normalization repair

theorem linePullback_components_horizontal
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f) (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (δ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).obj
        (finiteLine l E Y n) ≅ finiteLine l E X n)
    (hδ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (a : (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n).obj.obj U)
      (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf Y (l ^ (n + 1))).obj.obj U),
      (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv _ _)
        (δ n).hom).val.app U
          (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor Y l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
            U.unop a z) =
        Scheme.tateFiniteTensor X l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
          (chart f U).unop
          ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap.{u, u + 2} f CommRingCat.{u + 1}
            (CommRingCat.of (FiniteRing l E n))).hom.app U a)
          (restrictRoot l f n U z)) :
    let d := fun n ↦ (g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).app (lineModule l E cY) ≪≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).mapIso
        (lineEvaluation l E cY n) ≪≫ δ n ≪≫ (lineEvaluation l E cX n).symm
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      (SemilinearSections.transition.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
          (g.pull.obj (lineModule l E cY)) ≫
        (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X)
            (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h)).map (d n).hom =
      (d m).hom ≫ (SemilinearSections.transition.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
          (lineModule l E cX)
